name: tsumiki
description: 漫画PNは辻本リョウです

works.body:
I saw tsumiki's illustration and was attracted to the girl with beautiful eyes.
I was attracted to the girl with beautiful eyes and I was hoping you could draw my child.
Thank you very much.

◆Usage
Use of images on SNS such as twitter, icons, headers, etc.

Reference material for three views and characters
Here are some reference materials.
https://twitter.com/silas_012/status/1624678045637550083?s=20

◆Composition and others
Composition and poses are up to you!
Fountain pen is my favorite item, so I will be delighted if you can include it in the illustration.

I would appreciate it if you could consider it.
Thank you very much.

https://twitter.com/silas_012/status/1624678045637550083?s=20

I requested you to draw a character that I guessed.

The character is Kuroren from Tsukihime.
https://dic.pixiv.net/a/%E9%BB%92%E3%83%AC%E3%83%B3

As for the costume, I would like to dress Ren in various outfits, so I would be happy if you could draw some outfits original to tsumiki!

I'll leave the composition up to you, but I'd be happy if the pose emphasizes the legs.

I would appreciate it if you could do it.
